method: Direct item-body inspection of fifteen consecutive letters in the user-supplied Kehot publisher scan. PDF pages 466-481 were rendered and visually checked; page-resolved extracted text supported bounded research paraphrases. No blocked crawler was used.
identity_relation: Two identities (ד׳תרפה and ד׳תרצד) were established from visible page headings where the conservative index omitted them. Thirteen existing identities were enriched in place. The legacy OCR key ד׳תרחצ was corrected to the visible heading ד׳תרצח rather than retained as a duplicate identity.

evidence_family_dedup.counting_rule: The three letters document planning or reports around the same 5716 emissary tour and are not counted as three independent proofs of the tour's results.
This Yiddish follow-up belongs to the already inspected correspondence with Mary Wilensky (ד׳שמד); the Hebrew propositions are derived research paraphrases, not an independent translation witness.
The long letter continues the established ships correspondence and is not counted as independent confirmation of repeated technical claims.

verification_scope: Fifteen letter bodies were inspected across PDF pages 466-481. Incoming letters, cited publications, books and manuscripts, institutional records, ship logs, engineering evidence, rabbinic deliberations, employment contracts, medical or educational outcomes and later events were not independently inspected.
rights_note: Only bounded non-verbatim research paraphrases and exact locators were recorded; no protected letter was copied in full.
quality_note: All propositions are source-grounded paraphrases. Secretary signatures, Yiddish language, fragments, anonymous recipients, medical limitations, uninspected cross-references and shared evidence families remain explicit.
